annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika Republik Indonesia (Menteri Budi Arie Setiadi)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets nine ethical values: inclusivity, humanity, security, accessibility, transparency, credibility and accountability, personal data protection, sustainability, intellectual property.
Addressed to AI programming businesses and public and private electronic system operators.
AI must not be the sole policymaker or decision-maker on matters concerning humanity.
Requires attention to risk management and crisis management in AI development.
Oversight by government, operators and users to prevent misuse; supports education programs.
annotation.summary_en: Indonesian Minister of Communication and Informatics Circular No. 9 of 2023 on AI Ethics. It gives non-binding ethical guidance to AI programming businesses and public and private electronic system operators. It sets nine values, including inclusivity, security, transparency, accountability, data protection and sustainability, and assigns responsibilities. It contains no robot-specific provisions.
annotation.title_clean: Surat Edaran Menteri Komunikasi dan Informatika Nomor 9 Tahun 2023 tentang Etika Kecerdasan Artifisial
annotation.title_en: Circular of the Minister of Communication and Informatics No. 9 of 2023 on Artificial Intelligence Ethics
